accepted.quote: Ranking Member Takano offered a substitute amendment to Chaiman Bost's amendment in the nature of a substitute (A.N.S) to H.R. 2334 at the full Committee markup, in order to clarify that the Servicemember's Civil Relief Act (SCRA) tolls the period of actual possession necessary to establish a claim to a servicemember's real property under the doctrine adverse possession.
accepted.rationale: Takano offered an amendment to codify SCRA tolling of adverse possession periods for servicemember property.

new_issues.name: Servicemember Property Protections from Adverse Possession
